summary_zh: ThinkRail 是一个围绕 pi 编码代理构建的代理式 IDE，支持规格驱动开发，能随使用逐步学习项目；提供隔离的 git worktree 工作区以并行运行代理、Monaco 编辑器、终端、多功能聊天、规格图、技能与扩展、MCP 服务器、自定义模型提供方，以及桌面端和 CLI 两种形式。
audience_zh: 适合希望在多工作区中并行运行 AI 编码代理、用规格图维护项目知识，并需要编辑器、终端、PR 与 CI 集成、MCP 及自定义模型的开发者；也适合只用 CLI 或在浏览器中使用的用户。

evidence.quote: ThinkRail is an agentic IDE that gets better every time you use it. With Spec-Driven Development support, it learns your project as you work, becoming more capable and helpful over time.

We built a rich interface around the `pi` coding agent, isolated work into separate workspaces, and gave the agent durable project knowledge through the spec graph and reusable skills. We are now adding full extension support, so ThinkRail can create the tools it needs based on how you work.

- **Isolated workspaces.** Open any git repo as a project and create `git worktree` workspaces from it, each with its own branch and working directory. Agents can then work in parallel without touching your original codebase; when they finish, merge the results you want to keep and delete the rest.

- **An IDE around the agent.** ThinkRail comes with Monaco editor tabs, a file tree integrated with git to show code changes as they happen, terminals, and document support. Rendered Markdown previews have a heading outline that follows the section you're reading; hide it or move it to either side.
